title: Roman Imperial Coin – Constantine I “SOLI INVICTO COMITI” (Rome Mint)
description:
Emperor: Constantine I
 

 Authority (as listed by OCRE): Licinius
 

 Denomination: AE2 / AE3 (bronze)
 

 Mint: Rome, Italy (Latium)
 

 Date: AD 314
 

 Manufacture: Struck
 

 Material: Bronze


 Obverse:
 

 Laureate, draped, cuirassed bust of Constantine I, facing right.
 

 Legend: IMP CONSTANTINVS P F AVG


 Reverse:
 

 Sol standing left, radiate, with chlamys draped across left shoulder, raising right hand and holding globe in left hand.
 

 Legend: SOLI INV-I-CTO COMITI
 

 Deity: Sol


 Mint mark: R/F
 

 Officina mark: P, S, T, or Q



 Diameter: approx. 18.5mm
 

 Weight: approx. 2.55g
 



 Reference link (OCRE / RIC VII Rome 19):
 

  https://numismatics.org/ocre/id/ric.7.rom.19
 



 A classic Constantinian bronze type featuring Sol Invictus, suitable for collectors of Constantine I and late Roman bronze coinage.
